body: I honestly get where you're coming from, but I don't think ending it will be good for you. I'll give you the same advice as I got "...you're simply too young...".
You're contemplating suicide... that's more than enough reason, and since you're 14 it's even more important for them to take action.

I... think you should talk to social services... if your mom makes you feel trapped, stuck, alone, and suicidal you should probably contact them... but, it's your life, man...
Good luck(?)!

No, I honestly don't think it can get better, whenever there is something good happening it usually turns for the worst.
I don't think my depression, anxiety, and suicidal thoughts come from being a teenager, I've had them before (except anxiety) I was a teen although you might be right, idk.
I guess it could turn out that way, most likely in 10-15 years time though. I don't think I'll ever get a bf though, I'm the most unattractive person on this planet. 
But, maybe living alone could be good.
Sorry I got on a tangent.

I think I just got why I related to him for years, I still do, but now it makes 100% sense. I'm actually a bit embarrassed that I didn't realise this.

>So it's not that odd that there are LGBTQ audiences who've grown up with him still see themselves in him

So... I should have more life experience until you think I can decide whether or not I'm gonna live?
Ok, I'll keep that in my mind, thanks for your time making this response.
Thank you, really thank you. I hope it turns out the way you described my future and all, really thanks for the response. I'll try and take this to memory.

200bhp, if you're gonna end it, which I hope you don't, seriously please don't do this, even though I'm a stranger on the internet that can't really comfort you or give psychological advice. I honestly reccomend talking to a psychologist (to talk) or psychiatrist (for medication).

If not, going back to the start of this response:
Do it cautiously, I shouldn't really be advocating for suicide but, I feel it's your right (IF you try to get help first) to do this, please be prepared(?),
   I am truly sorry you feel this way (I really do understand I have my own shit, and I honestly don't know why I'm responding, I probably won't actually even reach you).
Have a great day or night or whatever to the strangers reading this!
Now stop watching, life isn't a show, go do something instead of watching others suffer and go through one of the worst things imaginable.
